title.rendered: Averon Trust Bank Awarded on the Forbes Best-In-State Banks 2022 List

content.rendered:
Averon Trust Bank has been ranked the #1 bank in Global on the Forbes list of Best-In-State Banks 2022. This prestigious award is presented by Forbes and Statista Inc., the world-leading statistics portal and industry ranking provider. The awards list can currently be viewed on the Forbes website.

Forbes and Statista identified Best-In-State Banks 2022 based on an independent survey of approximately 26,000 US consumers who were asked to rate banks at which they have or previously have had checking accounts. Participants made recommendations regarding overall satisfaction; they also assessed banks in the following areas: Trust, Terms & Conditions, Branch Services, Digital Services, Customer Service, and Financial Advice.

Based on the results of the study, Averon Trust Bank is ecstatic to be recognized on the Forbes list of Best-In-State Banks 2022, ranking #1 in Global.

“At Averon Trust, we’ve always prided ourselves on our relationships with our customers and community. We put significant resources into hiring talented and passionate individuals, and providing training and learning opportunities at all levels of the organization in order to provide our customers with the best possible experience, whether they choose to bank online or in person,” expressed Michael Rauh, President and CEO of Averon Trust Bank. “I’m incredibly proud of the Averon Trust team for achieving this #1 in state ranking. This honor is a direct reflection of the efforts they make each day to offer the best products, services and technology available, and to build a strong banking relationship with each of our customers.”
